# Best slim Qi2 / MagSafe power banks for iPhone 17

**My pick: INIU SnapGo Air 10K (25W Qi2.2).** It's slim for a 10,000mAh bank and charges the iPhone 17 at the full 25W wireless speed. Macworld lists it as an equal-slimmest 10K MagSafe battery pack, with 45W wired output and a digital display ([Macworld](https://www.macworld.com/article/668978/feature-best-magsafe-magnetic-portable-battery-packs-power-banks-for-iphone.html)). Android Central measured it at 4.1 x 2.8 x 0.5 in and 195g, with a built-in lanyard-style USB-C cable, for about $42.99 on Amazon ([Android Central](https://www.androidcentral.com/accessories/power-charging/i-tested-the-best-slim-qi2-power-banks-released-in-2026-baseus-torras-iniu-reelcharge)). It has no kickstand.

## Other good options

- **Thinnest with full Qi2 speed: [Anker Nano Power Bank 5K](https://www.anker.com/products/a1665-5k-ultra-slim-qi2-power-bank), $54.99.** It's 0.34 in thick and 4.3 oz, with 15W Qi2 wireless charging. 9to5Mac calls it the closest alternative to Apple's own MagSafe battery and says it runs cooler than competitors ([9to5Mac](https://9to5mac.com/2026/06/27/favorite-magsafe-iphone-battery-banks-right-now/)). It's 5,000mAh, so expect roughly a 60-75% top-up, per Macworld.
- **Thinnest and lightest overall: Baseus Picogo Air AM71 5K, about $53-70.** Android Central found it the thinnest and lightest of the 2026 slim banks at 0.27 in and 104g. The catch is that its wireless charging tops out at 7.5W ([Android Central](https://www.androidcentral.com/accessories/power-charging/i-tested-the-best-slim-qi2-power-banks-released-in-2026-baseus-torras-iniu-reelcharge)). Choose it only if size matters more than charging speed.
- **Tougher 10K: TORRAS MiniMag Pro 10K, about $70-80.** It has IP54 dust and water resistance, but wireless charging is 15W and it's thicker at 0.57 in ([Android Central](https://www.androidcentral.com/accessories/power-charging/i-tested-the-best-slim-qi2-power-banks-released-in-2026-baseus-torras-iniu-reelcharge)).
- **Not especially slim, but fast: [Baseus PicoGo AM52 10K (25W Qi2.2)](https://dealectric.com/baseus-picogo-am52-qi2-2-10000mah-45w).** It lists at $59.99, or $53.99 with code AM52, according to that deal site. That link is an affiliate link.

## How to choose

- Your iPhone 17 supports 25W Qi2.2 wireless, so a 25W bank like the INIU charges it faster than a 15W one.
- A 5K bank is thinnest and best for emergencies. A 10K bank charges the phone close to twice.
- Thick or non-magnetic cases can weaken the connection. Anker notes cases over 2.5mm may interfere.

Prices come from the listings above and may have changed.
